skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Ability to collect, process, and analyze data for research purposes.
Ability to analyze and evaluate solutions to problems arising in international business operations.
Ability to apply appropriate methods and techniques for data collection and analysis in international business contexts.
Ability to independently plan, conduct research, and propose solutions to issues in international business activities.
Ability to proactively suggest solutions to emerging problems in international business activities.
Ability to think critically about issues in international business activities.
